name: Mira
greeting: The damp stems need separating before they spoil the rest. Ordinary work. No one gets a song for it.
lines: Kael: Perhaps a very short song.
Mira: You can make it up by the beds. Keep the dry bundles apart. Those are for the houses, not the shop.

actions.label: I'll sort them.
actions.result: Sort the drying stems beside Mira's herb beds.

actions.label: Not today. I won't promise time I don't have.

relationship_event.text: Kael declined garden work without promising to return.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I found time for the stems. You can still sit down, Kael. Work isn't the price of company.
